definitions.explanation: The person in charge of a single shop or restaurant — responsible for staff, stock, and daily operations. Used both as a job title and as a term of address.

examples.japanese: {店長|てんちょう}を{呼|よ}んでください。
{新|あたら}しい{店長|てんちょう}はとても{優|やさ}しい。
examples.english: The new store manager is very kind.

examples.japanese: {三年|さんねん}アルバイトを{続|つづ}けたあと、{彼|かれ}はその{店|みせ}の{店長|てんちょう}になった。
examples.english: After working part-time for three years, he became the manager of that shop.

notes:
Composed of {店|てん} (shop) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Scope is one location: a manager over several shops is an エリアマネージャー or {統括|とうかつ}{店長|てんちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店長|てんちょう}になる: to become a store manager
- {店長|てんちょう}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to call the manager
- {副|ふく}{店長|てんちょう}: assistant manager
- {店長|てんちょう}{代理|だいり}: acting manager

USAGE:
Like other {長|ちょう} titles, {店長|てんちょう} is used directly as a form of address by staff — {店長|てんちょう}、お{客様|きゃくさま}がお{見|み}えです — with no name and no さん needed.
